description: This PHP class 'ConvertBinary' provides methods to convert binary strings to decimal, hexadecimal, and octal representations, including handling of two's complement for negative numbers. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine for engineering functions.

classes.name: ConvertBinary
classes.description: A class for converting binary strings to decimal, hex, and octal formats, with support for two's complement negative numbers.

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Converts a binary string to its decimal representation, handling two's complement for negatives.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts a binary string to its hexadecimal representation, with optional padding.

methods.name: toOctal
methods.description: Converts a binary string to its octal representation, with optional padding.

methods.name: validateBinary
methods.description: Validates that the binary string is at most 10 bits and contains only 0s and 1s.
